0.description: [Build Draft] Thunderbear - Added Anger Management and Precision Rare Enchants to improve pacing at early levels.
[Build Draft] Fixed an error where Shadowbear did not have drain soul.
[Build Draft] Eldritch Knight - Improved leveling flow and added Emanating Light into the max level PvE version.

[Build Draft] We will continue improving Build Draft Builds that have their power more weighted towards talents and abilities that require a high level and adding in Rare Mystic Enchants to improve their power and leveling flow!
[Build Draft] Plague Bear - Overall improvements to leveling flow and tanking ability.

[Build Draft] Blood Drinker - Replaced Backstab with Sinister Strike as intended and improved talent selection. Added Rare Mystic Enchants to early levels to improve the pacing as most of the build's enchants have higher level requirements.

[Build Draft] Ascendant - Added additional mana regeneration spells and talents to improve early game mana management. Added Rare Mystic Enchants to early levels to improve the pacing as most of the build's enchants have higher level requirements.

[Build Draft] Searing Blades - Improved early level mana regeneration. Reordered talent learns for smoother progression. Added Rare Mystic Enchants to early levels to improve the pacing as most of the build's enchants have higher level requirements.

[Build Draft] Locust Ranger	- Added Tame Beast to the leveling build. Changed the sort order of learned abilities and talents for smoother progression. Added Rare Mystic Enchants to help with early game mana regeneration and damage to account for this build requiring higher level spells and talents.
[Build Draft] Hellcat - Improved leveling flow. Replaced Demonic Mind with Fiery Charge Enchant. Added Vitality for early game energy regen and Wizard's Claw and Dreamstate for mana management.

[Build Draft] Dragoon - Added an early heal spell and added Slam to the build. Added Rare Mystic Enchants to early levels to improve the pacing as most of the build's enchants have higher level requirements.

[Build Draft] Storm Giant - Added additional mana regeneration spells and talents. Adjusted spell learns and Enchant learns to make more sense. Added Wizard’s Thunder Clap and Precision to help with early game damage and mana management.
[Build Draft] Frozen Titan- Added more early level mana regeneration options! Added Wizard's Sinister Strike to ensure smoother mana management.
[Build Draft] Grove Ranger - Improved early game mana regeneration talents. Added Dreamstate and Wizard’s Arcane Shot to ensure a smooth gameplay flow and mana management.

[Build Draft] Tidecaller - Improved learn order of spells and talents. Added Rare Mystic Enchants to early levels to improve mana management and account for the build's enchants having higher level requirements.
[Requires Launcher Update] Added more information to the challenge failure indicators on the world map.

Increased the damage that the original 9 classes deal against monsters by approximately 18 to 20% in instances while at max level. This buff is meant to bring up their overall performance and increase the overall viability to perform inside of content.
Fixed an issue where Mauradon and Scarlet Monastery would take you to the wrong entrance.
Fixed an issue where Heroic (and mythic when it releases) was not dropping loot in some lower level heroic and mythic dungeons.
[AddOn: VuhDo] Fixed extreme framerate issue
[Build Draft Thunderbear]  60 PvE build removed Leader of the Pack in exchange for Lightning Shield as intended.
[Pending Patch Update] - Polished the New Glyph Mystic Scrolls for the Original 9 Classes, adding icons, tooltips and correcting their enchant status on the items they're enchanted onto.

7.description: [Pending restart] Storm of Sword now increases the damage of Slam by less in PvP than PvE, fixing an issue where it was far too bursty against players.
[Archimonde] Glyphs will be temporarily disabled whilst we fix some issues and outlier behaviour with them!

Fixed an issue where Battle Charge from Battle Fervor could incorrectly target players when the tooltip specified creatures. Charge still remains usable against players while this Legendary is equipped.

1.description: [Build Draft] [Blademaster] Adjusted a few talents in the max level PvE version of this build to be slightly less offensive and more tanky.
[Build Draft] [Demoniac] Added the Battlemage talent at levels 17-19 in order to help this build sustain mana while leveling.
[Archimonde] Fixed an issue where Retribution Aura for the Trial Classes had far more SP scaling than intended. It now scales from 3.3% of your Spell damage.
[Build Draft Blood Drinker] Fixed an issue where Blood Drinker was teaching Backstab instead of Sinister Strike. If this is your active build, opening up Hero Architect will update your build!

0.description: [Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Travel Form (Original 9 Classes) - Was not increasing movement speed.

[Pending Restart] - Taunts on Original 9 Classes can no longer miss. (This is due to a change where we had increased the hit chance requirement from taunts from 8 to 14% with the hybrid update but also made taunts unable to miss).

[Pending Restart] - Reworked the item level algorhythm for deciding what loot you should get from your Callboard Cache and Legion Invasions. If you were too high of an item level and were placed into the next tier for loot, your box would not grant loot, this issue has been fixed.
[Pending Restart] Divine Judgement from Divine Purpose now increases Penance damage by 25% per stack versus players, changed from 75%.
[Build Draft Marksman] Fixed an issue where the PvP version did not learn Aimed Shot. You can swap between PvE and PvP builds to fix active builds.
[Requires Restart] Warlock armors are now persistant through death
[Requires Restart] Mage armors are now persistant through death
[Requires Restart] Warrior stances are now persistant through death
Taunts can no longer miss
[Build Draft Plague Bear] Fixed an issue where the Plague Bearer Legendary Enchant was not being applied in PvE build. You can swap between PvP and PvE to fix active builds.
[Requires Launcher Update] Fixed an issue where the Shieldsmasher Mystic Enchant wasn't visible.
[Archimonde] You no longer heal for 15% less while in High-Risk.
[BladedancerBuild Draft] 60 PvE: Removed Sprint and Added Killing Spree as intended to be used with the Massaccre Epic Enchant. Swap between PvP and PvE to update your build.
[Locust Ranger Build Draft] 60 PvE: corrected issue where it had 4 Mystic Enchants, causing it to fail to apply any enchants. Swap between PvP and PvE builds to update active builds.
[Bulwark Build Draft] 60 PvE version fixed to include Drain Soul and added missing stacks of rare mystic enchants. Cycle between PvP and PvE build to fix active builds.

[Stormhammer Build Draft] Swapped Last Stand for Concussive Blow in the End-Game PvP build as this was a required spell. You can swap between PvE and PvP builds to update if you have this build active.
[Thunderbear Build Draft] Fixed an issue where the max level PvE build did not Drain Soul. You can switch to the PvP build, then back to the PvE build to fix already active builds!
Enabled Resolute Gamemode
Rogues will now properly learn Pick Lock at level 16.
[Requires Restart] Fixed an problem where players would end up with the wrong riding skill.
[Requires Restart] Fixed an issue where enchants would be removed from items bought from the Auctionhouse.
[Requires Restart] Fixed all Woodcutting spawns in Highrisk. They were not spawned properly.
Fixed an issue where Woodcutting was not on the Book of Artisans
Fixed problems with talent investment applying as a Hero at 60.
Fixed an issue that could cause you to lose your Empty Water Chalice.
Extended descriptions of Trials and added a scroll bar with additional details that were only previously available on hover over.
[Requires Restart] Updated Sellprice on new Glyph Mystic Scrolls.
Fixed an issue that would result in players losing their trials without intention with group invites.
Improved Profession XP Calculation to catch some outlier items.
Fixed an issue where Druid was not learning Maul in Bear form.

7.description: [Power of Omens] Fixed an issue where Sunder could not trigger the effects.
[Cryotherapist] Spirit Frost no longer requires critical hits to proc. This will further enhance the early game healing potential while leveling. (Pending Restart)

[Cryotherapist] Added baseline healing to Cryotherapy heal over time. This will ensure you have effective healing at low levels before your Frostbolt damage starts really scaling. This will be very noticable at lower levels and less noticable at max level.
Fixed an issue where casting instant Shadow Bolts while in Corrupted Bear Form would take you out of form.
[Defias Gunslinger] Clarified the tooltip to make it more clear that Swashbuckling requires a single 1 handed weapon with an open off-hand.

1.description: Fixed an issue where Frozen Orb rank 2 would not deal damage for the whole duration.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where using Gloomblade would remove Metamorphosis.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where using Angelic Feather would remove Tree of Life.

2.description: [High Risk] Fixed an issue where High-Risk material events were not set to always on. High-Risk materials will drop at these locations next restart.

0.description: [Requires Launcher Update] You can now see the level you will obtain Mystic Enchants in build draft on the Hero Architect
Fixed an issue where players were not getting Mercenary for Hire at level 15. Keep in mind this replaces criminal intent players used to get at level 20 in past seasons.
Teleport Moonglade can now be learned at trainers for Druid.
[Requires Restart] Fixed an issue where PVP Flagging would not occur until level 20-25. It should properly occur at 15 now.
[Requires Restart] Fixed an issue where OG classes could not queue BGs.

In addition to the base achievement, the titles rewarded from "Reach Level X (Insert Race)" is now also available from achieving that Realm First on ALL of the classes available for that race in League 4.
[Thrall] Chimera shot- Serpent sting Damage increased by 20% in pvp combat (The recent pvp power bugfix hit this spell a little to hard alongside the 15% nerf that was pushed)

7.description: [Dark Ranger ] - The damage from the direct hits and dot portions of Dark Arrows, Shadow Artillery and Shadow Arrow has gained a PVP mod from level 1-59.  Starting at level one with a -30% mod, then getting 0.5% damage added per level up to level 60. This will not affect anything at level 60 or above.

1.description: [Lights Vengeance] Fixed an issue where this ability was not correctly scaling from SP/AP

2.description: [Pending Restart] Hotspot: Bonus XP Locations will now have more clearer display as to which area they belong to as well as hundreds of poor locations removed from the pool.

[Requires Launcher Update] You can now configure the distance and vertical positioning of NamePlates. These options can be found in [Esc -> Interface -> Combat]
[Requires Launcher Update] Added several new draft configuration options, including auto revealing of cards. These can be found in [Esc -> Interface -> Draft Options].
[AddOn Update] WeakAuras can now anchor to NamePlates.
[AddOn Update] ElvUI NamePlates have been completely modernized. These are far more efficient fps-wise and come with very powerful configuration options, including resizing the clickable area

7.description: [Pending Restart][Righteous Flames] Casting Inner Fire now also triggers an explosion around your target.
[Pending Restart][Righteous Flames] Righteous Flames now lasts for 15 seconds. Up from 10.
[Pending Restart][Righteous Flames] Righteous Flames now increases the damage of your next Holy Fire by 20% (5% versus players). Up from 12%/4% respectively.
[Pending Restart][Righteous Flames] Holy Fire (Righteous Flames) now grants 5 charges of Inner Fire per enemy hit. It refreshed all charges previously.
[Righteous Flames] Fire spells now consume 3 charges of your Inner Fire.
